question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Camouflage
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Reveal**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Camouflage **means to hide or disguise something by blending it in with its surroundings. (छलावरण)

 
 
• **Example**: *The soldiers used camouflage to blend in with the forest and remain unseen by the enemy.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Reveal **means to make something known or visible. (प्रकट कर
